candidateAudit.text: Some places serve great food. Others make you feel genuinely welcome. And then there are places that do both. 🤎 If you’re visiting Vienna with little ones, I have a recommendation you shouldn’t miss! Right in the heart of Vienna, we discovered a place that deserves a special mention: Ströck – Feierabend Burggasse. As parents of two little children, we know that going out for brunch during peak hours isn’t always easy. Sometimes, all you want is to enjoy a meal without feeling like your children are an inconvenience. But here, it was completely different. No uncomfortable looks, no sighs, no feeling that we were taking up too much space. Instead, we were welcomed with open arms and offered some of the best seats in the house, even during busy hours, so that both we and our children could feel comfortable. And the food? Absolutely delicious! The atmosphere? Amazing. The hospitality? Even better. ✨ I genuinely and wholeheartedly recommend Ströck – Feierabend Burggasse to parents visiting Vienna with children. Because family-friendly hospitality isn’t just about having a high chair. It’s about making families feel that they belong. 🤎 📍 Ströck – Feierabend Burggasse, Vienna #ugccreator #viennafood #viennawithkids #familyfriendlyvienna #familylifestyle

candidateAudit.title: 🇷🇴 Aluat subțire, o lingură de dulceață, o ploaie de zahăr pudră… ce să fie oare? Sunt Clătitele noastre, adică Palatschinken pe limba vienezilor: foi fine, rumenite la tigaie și
candidateAudit.text: 🇷🇴 Aluat subțire, o lingură de dulceață, o ploaie de zahăr pudră… ce să fie oare? Sunt Clătitele noastre, adică Palatschinken pe limba vienezilor: foi fine, rumenite la tigaie și rulate cu dulceață de căpșuni sau de afine, iar pentru cei cu poftă de ciocolată, cu cremă de ciocolată. Un desert românesc la Viena care se termină mereu mai repede decât crezi. Duminica asta, lasă-ți ultimul loc de pe masă pentru o porție de clătite. 🇦🇹 Zart, goldgelb, süß und aufgerollt – na, was könnte das wohl sein? Natürlich Palatschinken, bei uns Clătite genannt: hauchdünn in der Pfanne gebacken und wahlweise mit Erdbeermarmelade, mit Heidelbeermarmelade oder mit Schokocreme gefüllt. Eine rumänische Nachspeise in Wien, die am Teller selten lange Zeit zum Abkühlen hat. Heb dir für diesen Sonntag ein Eckerl Platz auf und bestell sie zum Schluss. 🇬🇧 Thin, golden, rolled up and ready for jam or chocolate: our clătite are Romanian crêpes that make a very good case for dessert first. Come by this Sunday and order a stack. 📍 Sechshauser Gürtel 7, 1150 Wien · 🕛 zilnic 12:00–22:30 📞 +43 650 564 1000 . #mancarecalamamaacasa #palatschinken #dessert #donaudelta #restaurantromanesc #romaniinviena #mancareromaneasca #romanidinaustria #rumänischesrestaurant #rumänischeküche #restaurantwien #wienisst #wien1150 #viena #rudolfsheimfünfhaus #romanianfood #viennafood #foodwien
